_note: INDICATIVE scrap rates only, NOT a live or official price list. Values are representative mid-points compiled from publicly published Indian scrap-pickup rate sheets and paper-trade listings (Delhi NCR, ~Oct 2026). Real rates vary by locality, cleanliness, sorting and daily market; verify before any real-world use. In this project the price is a convenience shown on the receipt, NOT the pitch (see CLAUDE.md #7). Everything here is synthetic/indicative.
